title: Throttle chat streaming renders and cache markdown turn output
description: Vetted from Audit #7 findings 1.1 and 1.2. Chat rendering currently calls StateHasChanged per streaming delta and re-renders markdown for all turns each cycle. Implement throttled render ticks (target 4-8Hz), delta buffering, and per-turn rendered markdown caching keyed by stable turn identity/hash. Include regression tests and a measurable render-latency improvement target.

comments.author: AgentSmith
